tldr: Apple unveiled new iPhone 18 handsets, Apple Watch models, and AirPods 5, also introducing its Siri AI as a beta feature in the upcoming iOS 27.
Oil prices exceeded $100 a barrel for the first time since July, prompted by escalating strikes between the US and Iran near the Strait of Hormuz.
The US Treasury initiated a $6 billion government debt buyback to alleviate pressure in the bond market, where yields had risen to their highest point since 2008.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both declined, reflecting a general risk-off sentiment in the market. This decline coincided with oil prices rising above $100 a barrel due to intensified conflict in the Middle East, specifically after US and Iranian strikes.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield saw a slight increase. This occurred despite the US Treasury announcing a $6 billion government debt buyback intended to alleviate pressure in the bond market, where yields had reached their highest levels since 2008.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, rose, indicating increased investor apprehension. This aligns with broader 'risk-off sentiment' noted in the market.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased for the week ending September 3, 2026. This rise tracks the general upward movement in the 10-year Treasury yield, which had been experiencing significant increases, reaching its highest point since 2008.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_week.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

tech.summary: Apple showcased its latest products, including the iPhone 18 Pro with a dynamic-aperture main camera, the Apple Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5. The company also announced the launch of iOS 27 on September 14th, featuring the new Siri AI.
Google is making its largest single investment in Europe by selecting Finland for a €13 billion data center project, which is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs.

Microsoft has established new AI privacy rules for schools through an agreement with the American Federation of Teachers, following concerns that led two major school systems to ban student-facing AI.

world.summary: Oil prices have surged past $100 a barrel for the first time since July, following claims by Iran that it attacked 10 ships near the Strait of Hormuz in response to US strikes that reportedly sank five Iranian tankers.

Prominent Israelis have expressed support for new UK sanctions targeting illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, viewing them as a necessary response to expansion and violence in the region.
The Metropolitan police have launched an inquiry into allegations that Reform UK plotted to violate electoral law by accepting overseas donations, with the party stating it will cooperate fully.
Drone attacks between Russia and Ukraine continue, with three deaths reported in Ukraine and four in Russia. Additionally, two people died at the Moldovan border during the ongoing conflict.

us.summary: Flight data indicates that an Amazon cargo plane attempted to abort an unsteady landing at Miami International Airport before crashing into a van, resulting in five fatalities.

New York City has released 170,000 documents that reportedly show city officials were aware of the dangerous air quality around the World Trade Center site after 9/11 but did not adequately warn residents.

A National Guard member deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a crime-fighting task force, was arrested for allegedly pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member during a dispute over haircut regulations.

science.summary: Genetically modified pig kidneys have successfully kept two kidney failure patients alive long enough to receive human kidney transplants, marking a significant step in xenotransplantation.
Bangladesh is grappling with a severe measles outbreak, with over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases this year and more than 1,000 child deaths, prompting efforts to control the spread.
